items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Then I got J. C. Heard to play in Basie's band.

ctx.x: the way into Chicago. Al 's brother, a beautiful little boy that played with Lionel Hampton, and I went to Omaha out to my farm for two days. Then I came back and I stayed for three more weeks waiting on Shadow Wilson. Then I got J. C. Heard to play in Basie's band. We was playing the Adams Theatre.
Oh, in Detroit. Detroit, Michigan, that was.
